name: mtRAG
description: We present MTRAG-UN, a benchmark for exploring open challenges in multi-turn retrieval augmented generation, a popular use of large language models. We release a benchmark of 666 tasks containing over 2,800 conversation turns across 6 domains with accompanying corpora. Our experiments show that retrieval and generation models continue to struggle on conversations with UNanswerable, UNderspecified, and NONstandalone questions and UNclear responses. Our benchmark is available at https://github.com/IBM/mt-rag-benchmark
reputation: A new multi-turn RAG benchmark that is notable for using human-generated conversations and tasks across multiple domains.
notes: Focuses on multi-turn RAG conversations with challenges like unanswerable and non-standalone questions; explores synthetic data and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation.
